segments.text: QuickBite HQ. A cramped co-working space that smells like test-kitchen grease and ambition. Whiteboards everywhere. Post-its on the ceiling.
You're the new Executive Assistant. Your first day. You don't even have a login yet.
YOU! New person! I need the food cost ratio for the Volcano Burger BY NOON or Diana will kill the launch!
Ignore him. I need a competitive analysis deck for the investor call. Which is in — fifty-five minutes. With citations.
Hi! Sorry! Also the POS system is down at Store #4. And Store #7's fryer is literally on fire. Not metaphorically. Welcome aboard!
Three founders. Ten stores. One investor call in fifty-five minutes. And nobody can answer a single question because the data lives in fifteen different places.
Your sixty minutes start now.
INCOMING: Investor call moved up. Diana needs you in the War Room in 2 minutes.
They moved it up! The call is NOW! Get in here — do you have the numbers? Do you have the deck?
TELL THEM ABOUT THE VOLCANO BURGER!
Diana's already dialing. The boardroom screen blinks to life. Three investors stare back. This is happening.
The investor call ends. Diana's face cracks — is that a smile? That might be a smile.
INVESTMENT CONFIRMED. Series C secured.
I TOLD you. The Volcano Burger! They loved the numbers! They said 'impressive margins!' That's the sauce!
They loved the research. The competitive analysis. The fact that we had CITATIONS. On your first day.
Store #10's opening sequence just ran automatically. Every step. No tickets. No scramble. I didn't get a single phone call.
That's... that's never happened before.
Three founders look at you. The new hire. Who organized the chaos, researched the market, automated the opening, and won the money. On day one.
So. Chief Operating Officer. Interested?
You take a bite of the Volcano Burger. It's perfect.
Time expired. Investor call: incomplete.
The investors smile politely. 'Send us the deck when it's ready.' The kind of polite that means no.
We'll get them next time. The data was there — we just need to be faster at connecting it.
Store #10 opened anyway. There were... issues. But nobody got hurt. Mostly.
The Volcano Burger was still perfect. That part went great.
Tomorrow you'll know where to find everything. How to research faster. How to automate instead of scramble. Quick learns, and so do you.
